current_osm_api.identification_basis: Distinctive west-projecting circular front tower, broad west transverse wing, narrow east wing and connecting body; 2010 camera GPS west of this footprint and official museum-south/river-north context corroborate identity. API has no name tag.

source_bindings.height_note: Frozen low-detail city estimate; not the height of the authored historical building.

coordinate_frame.caveat: Map-fitted footprint and dimensions are inferred context placement, not a measured plan. Low-detail map height is not historical building height.

photo_map_fitting: OSM footprint locates the independent building; 2010 front-door camera GPS and official museum-south/river-north context corroborate identity. 2022 overhead photograph supports centered circular tower, symmetric rounded front wings, low barrel connector and smaller rear wing; selected dimensions remain estimated.

actual_geometry_and_collision.method: Union actual raw/web/LOD indexed triangles clipped exactly to local z[0,2]; 0.05m mitre buffer and topology-preserving0.02m simplification. Actual low floor/slab/steps cover the bounded building interior, so no synthetic interior or exterior courtyard fill is added. Overhead balcony/roof projection never substitutes for ground.

asset_binding.method: Actual shipped GLTFLoader + MeshoptDecoder; visible scene meshes, referenced indices within drawRange, complete node world and instance matrices. Actual indexed triangles exported, not a convex-hull or accessor-only approximation. CPU only, no WebGL.

model_ground_bindings.source_shape_caveat: Map footprint is coarse and asymmetric; 2022 overhead photograph supports symmetric front wings and centered circular tower. Differences are estimated photo fitting, not additional replaced owners.

actual_geometry_and_collision.limits: Map-fitted and photo-fitted dimensions remain estimates. Neighbor tests distinguish every mapped footprint, actual shared-near owner projection, and old candidate metadata checks; hidden facade detail is not surveyed.

height_only_revision_method.method: Actual final GLTFLoader/meshopt decoded triangle arrays independently compared with frozen v5. Canonical exact XY triangle multisets prove full projected geometry unchanged. Canonical exact actual XYZ triangles intersecting ground z=[0,2] prove low geometry unchanged. All modified referenced heights are six specified roof/platform datums, lowered 0.04m within float32 tolerance; no model/source planar mask changes.

existing_integration_check.scope: Existing candidate replacement/collision/site metadata only, no old assets replayed. New source clip has zero overlap with all existing candidate masks and collisions.

proposed_placement_contract.local_axes: Author x east,y north,z up; GLB x east,y up,z south. Circular entrance faces west.

placement.note: 按独立飞机楼OSM地图源定位；圆塔、对称圆角前翼和后翼按2013及2022照片规整拟合，尺寸与隐面含估计。

proposed_placement_contract.model_scope: 中国航空协会旧址飞机形独立楼现状外观：西圆塔、两侧圆角前翼、中央低筒拱连接舱与东后横翼；不并入现代医院邻楼、室内、树木、水体或庭院。
proposed_placement_contract.registration_note: Only independent airplane source1349 is replaced. Its irregular map footprint anchors the placement; facade symmetry and circular tower are photograph-fitted estimates. Every other nearby source owner is retained.

proposed_placement_contract.collision_navigability_limit: Overview-only. Low slabs and entrance thresholds are conservative building collision, not a surveyed interior route or hospital public-access certification. Side ground under the elevated east balcony remains open.
proposed_placement_contract.source_retained_actual_native_projection: All airplane1349 native near and far projection is contained by the narrow source-only clip; other near owner geometries are protected.
